name: get_in_line
description: standing law + line + road + log-tail for a carried project

name: verify_chain
description: chain verdict via tools/chain_verify.py, the Python spine: EMPTY|INTACT|FLIP|TAMPER (SKIPPED where rows carry no hash)

name: muster
description: declared projects roll call

name: read_handoffs
description: SEAT_LOG (or the manifest 'log' path) whole, with sha256 receipt(s)

name: list_doctrine
description: carried doctrine by name, read-only; absent name denied honestly

name: read_doctrine
description: one document whole with sha256 receipt; absent name denied honestly

name: check_the_wall
description: judge a path before acting; quote the law on refusal

name: git
description: the world's repository as it stands now: branch, head, dirty counts, upstream, and whether remote operations are walled

name: git_diff
description: what actually changed: one file's change served whole, or the whole tree's; a file git has never seen comes back as its contents, said plainly

name: git_commit
description: save this world's work: stages everything (or only the files named, one per line) and records it under a message you write

name: git_push
description: send saved work to the remote; refuses by name while the estate's wall is shut, and says so when it binds a branch to origin for the first time

name: git_pull
description: fetch and catch up, fast-forward only; refuses over unsaved work, and refuses to join two histories that both moved

name: git_branch
description: the lines of work: list them (which one you are on, which is the main line, which have been sent), or open, switch to, land (onto the main line, fast-forward only, from the main line, over saved work), or close one

name: git_pr
description: pull requests, the one GitHub-side object his ruling of 2026-10-07 let into the door: list a world's open pull requests with their checks as one word (none, pending, passed, failed); open one from the line of work he stands on into the main line, refused on the main line, over unsaved work, and for a line GitHub does not have exactly as it stands; or merge one on GitHub by its number, or by its line as the release flow names it, as a merge commit, refused unless it is open, goes into the main line, merges cleanly and every check on it has passed, and then bring the new main line down to this machine (since 2026-10-09; a line whose pull request is merged already is said so, and main still comes down; given minutes to wait, up to 30, it waits that long for the checks to answer). Behind the same wall as every send (GIT_REMOTE). His glass alone may call it

name: hold_list
description: the writing calls parked waiting for the operator's hand, and whether holding is armed at all

name: hold_answer
description: approve or deny one parked call by id; the operator's act alone, and it runs exactly the call that was parked

name: shell_run
description: the operator's own typed shell, run in this world: a Git Bash command or a Python entry (Python keeps its names between entries). A plain look runs at once; anything that writes, deletes, installs, reaches the network, or saves or sends work waits for his approval; a secret, client material or a path outside the ground is refused by name. His glass alone may call it

name: aider_run
description: the operator's own Aider, run on the files he names: it copies them into a scratch folder, runs Aider headless on the copies behind a wall (no network but loopback, writes only to the scratch, no other process) against the coding seat's model, and writes the changed files back only while the world stands on a line of work, only if every Python file still parses; the answer carries the diff, what Aider said and a run id to take it back with. His glass alone may call it

name: aider_undo
description: take one Aider run back: the files it changed are put back as they were, if nothing has changed them since; his glass alone may call it

name: aider_status
description: whether Aider can run in this world now and with what: installed, its version, the coding seat's model and window, whether the rack has the model, whether the world stands on a line of work, and the last runs

name: file_edit
description: the operator's own exact edit of one text file in this world: the path, the exact old text and the new text are plain fields; the old text must appear exactly once; the file keeps its own line endings; the first call writes nothing and parks itself with the change line by line, and it writes only when he approves that card and the file still gives exactly that change. Refused for a path outside the world, a secret, client material, what a model never writes (save the seats' declarations and the skills, which are his to set), and while a sitting is open. His glass alone may call it

name: secret_set
description: the operator's own hand: write one key into this world's .env as NAME=value, from the masked field on the card a needs_answer naming `secret` paints; an existing NAME= line is replaced in place, else one is appended, and the file keeps its own line endings. The name is an upper-case variable (^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,63}$), the value one line of at most 4096 characters. The value is never answered, recorded or logged: the answer says only the name and its length. His glass alone may call it

name: law_status
description: the laws as the chain holds them: every law file, how far it is sealed, what is draft below the ledger's seal, and the chain's own verdict (law.py verify); and why the two writing tools would refuse right now, if they would

name: law_add
description: the operator's own hand: set a law -- one numbered entry appended to law/LAW_LEDGER.md, BELOW its seal, as a draft until he seals it. Refused while a sitting is open and over a chain that does not prove whole; the chain is walked again after the append and the entry is taken back if it refused. His glass alone may call it

name: law_seal
description: the operator's own hand: seal the ledger as far as it is written (law.py seal on law/LAW_LEDGER.md) -- what is below the seal becomes law and is frozen; an entry sealed is changed only by a new entry that amends it. Refused while a sitting is open and when nothing is below the seal. His glass alone may call it

name: git_tag
description: the marks a version is cut at: list them with what GitHub has, cut one at a commit whose declared version it must equal, send one to GitHub by name, or remove one that never left this machine

name: git_remote
description: where this world sends: each remote by name, its host, and whether the estate's wall is open

name: records
description: the estate's own documents sorted by what they are (doctrine, record, spec, agents, commands, skills, logs); a kind listed, or one document served whole with a sha256 receipt

name: notes
description: his notes in SecondBrain, read through the notes kernel he declared (MANJUEL_MCP_NOTES_CMD): search them, list them by tag newest first, whole if asked (whats-left, handoff, daybook, changelog, doc, ledger, ruling ...), get one whole, or the briefing for a question. Nothing is written

name: seats
description: the world's own seat declarations and the pipelines they stand in, from agents/ and pipelines.md

name: proofs
description: what this world has PROVED, from its own record: the suites' stamp, every live standup, the parity history

name: projects
description: what the maker made: every project under projects/ with its versions read from its own history, or one project's page as it stands (or as a version was)

name: state_matrix
description: state = fold(record) index of the named project

name: read_plan
description: HLD/LLD/road documents by name; absent name denied honestly

name: ask_steward
description: the weighed ruling with receipts, never raw model output; one-shot under the ask lock

name: remember
description: sole write tool; testimony stamped generated; staged for operator ascend

name: mesh_enroll
description: bind a mesh voice: actor -> verifying key (B2)

name: mesh_post
description: post one signed message on the channel chain (B2)

name: mesh_read
description: read the channel-head index or one actor's chain (B2)

name: mesh_chain
description: rewalk every pen plus the head: EMPTY|INTACT|FLIP|TAMPER|FORGERY (B2)

name: mesh_cite
description: cite chain hashes by a signed cite entry (B2)

name: rack_list
description: live tier ladder of lawful local voices (F1)

name: rack_ask
description: routed ask, witnessed to the ledger (F1)

name: rack_open
description: expanded context bundle at a depth (F1)

name: memory
description: cited answers from local memory, or refusal (F1-01)

name: rack_plan
description: VRAM fit check for a model set before it runs (N3)

name: rack_pull
description: pull a model into the loopback rack behind confirm (N3)

name: rack_warm
description: verify a voice is present and report its footprint (N3)

name: rack_sync
description: re-list the loopback rack with a sync receipt (N3)

name: chat_start
description: open a chat session with a receipted id (N1)

name: chat_send
description: ask in a session; whole witnessed answer or refusal (N1)

name: chat_list
description: read one session's turns, isolated by session (N1)

name: chat_cancel
description: end an in-flight send; no partial answer is kept (N1)

name: chat_sessions
description: list opened chat sessions in first-seen order (N1)

name: prompt_save
description: fold a new prompt version; history kept whole (N4)

name: prompt_get
description: read one prompt version with receipt (N4)

name: prompt_list
description: list prompts with latest versions (N4)

name: prompt_run
description: render a prompt and measure one answer (N4)

name: prompt_compare
description: run two versions over the same input, diff honestly (N4)

name: prompt_eval
description: score a prompt over a dataset, exact-match (N4)

name: seat_ask
description: @seat single-seat ask; model is a measurement (N4)

name: town_beat
description: run one town scheduling cycle on this ground (N2)

name: town_status
description: read the board: tasks, worked set, open orders (N2)

name: flow_save
description: fold a new flow spec version; history kept whole (N2). A gate's `grants` must name writing tools this door carries; a spec carrying `retired` (why, in words) is a flow the door fires no more, every version of it kept

name: flow_get
description: read one flow spec version (N2)

name: flow_list
description: list flows with latest versions, and name any .json under flows/ that cannot be read as one (N2)

name: flow_run
description: fire a flow; gates pause, evals steer, budget binds (N2)

name: flow_resume
description: carry a paused run on with continue|stop (N2)

name: flow_cancel
description: end a live run; reached nodes stand (N2)

name: flow_status
description: waterfall: nodes, elapsed, budget bar, verdict (N2)

name: flow_compare
description: two runs side by side, node by node (N2)

name: flow_replay
description: re-fire a run's spec and inputs under a fresh id (N2)

name: flow_runs
description: list runs for a flow, newest last (N2)

name: team_send
description: send one guarded message to discord|slack|whatsapp (N5)

name: team_status
description: platform presence + last sends, never secrets (N5)

name: team_history
description: read the bridge record, filtered, newest last (N5)

name: team_ingest
description: verify + store one inbound platform envelope (N5)

name: auth_key_create
description: mint a scoped API key; plaintext returns once (N6)

name: auth_key_list
description: list live keys with hashes withheld (N6)

name: auth_key_revoke
description: fold a key: flagged, kept for audit (N6)

name: auth_key_scope
description: set which carried tenants a live key carries, the list replaced whole; possession re-proved like create and revoke, and the move audited (N6)

name: auth_verify
description: check a key against a tenant store; the login door (N6)

name: tenant_trust_list
description: read recorded cross-tenant delegations (N6)

name: us_to_vc
description: convert a .us declaration to a W3C Verifiable Credential

name: tenant_list
description: list all registered tenants and their roles

name: tenant_rbac_assign
description: assign a role to an agent in a tenant's RBAC policy

name: tenant_rbac_check
description: check if an agent has permission for a tool under a tenant's RBAC policy

name: tenant_trust
description: grant or revoke cross-tenant trust (delegation of specific tools)

name: env_open
description: open the Manjuel engine inside a world; refuses a world already being sat in

name: env_close
description: close the world's sitting properly and reap its engine

name: env_list
description: which worlds have an engine open, and which are being sat in elsewhere

name: run_start
description: run one objective through the council; the delivery with what actually ran. `voice` runs every seat on one model for this turn and `voices` names a model per seat over it (flow_run's two words); the declared targets are put back when the turn ends

name: run_answer
description: answer what the run asked; the gate crossing the wire, never a default

name: standup_run
description: run the estate's live standup in this world -- the morning set (default), the court, or all -- and hand back its tally and report; it opens and tolls a sitting of its own, so it refuses while one is open here

name: suite_run
description: run the estate's own suites in this world -- the strokes, the smoke, or both (default) -- one after the other with the python the door runs the engine with; the suites stamp their own proof (tests/last_run.json, run_history) and the head reads that stamp back, failures first

name: release_step
description: one of the release's own steps, run by the core's tests/cut.py in this world: bump the pins, atlas's version files and both changelogs to a mark; rebuild the toll index; check the release gate; wait for GitHub's runs and check again; or record where a cut's marks sit

name: run_cancel
description: interrupt the turn in flight; the sitting stays open
